queries.result: First-party discovery identified Tamil Nadu Government Land Management System (TN-GLMS), Tamil Nadu land-record e-Services, the Department of Survey and Settlement TamilNilam Geo-Info service, and the Sivaganga district Survey and Land Record page. The district page explicitly includes Karaikudi taluk and describes digitization of FMB and computerized land records. No public bounded parcel feature response was exposed by discovery.

registryEvidence: The official Sivaganga district Survey and Land Record page identifies the district Survey and Land Records function, lists Karaikudi among its taluks, and describes digitization of FMB and computerized land records. Tamil Nadu Government TN-GLMS and Department of Survey and Settlement services provide the state public map/land-record leads. This evidences a local district/state registry custodian, not a verified parcel API response.

officialSources.observation: Official Sivaganga district page: Survey and Land Record department; Karaikudi is listed as a taluk; page describes FMB digitization, computerized land records and online patta transfer. No parcel API schema or geometry response exposed.

Tamil Nadu Government Land Management System describes integration of RoR, cadastral maps/FMB and related land systems and links to land-record services. No bounded anonymous parcel response was observed.

Government Services Portal describes official Tamil Nadu Patta, A-Register, FMB/Chitta/TSLR query flows by district, rural/urban area, taluk/town, village/ward, survey and subdivision. It is a service description, not a geometry endpoint.

Department of Survey and Settlement TamilNilam Geo-Info description says map and survey/subdivision navigation can visualize land records and FMB sketches. No safe public API or parcel geometry was obtained.

Official Tamil Nadu GIS application directory and disclaimer; public GIS lead, but no parcel response was retained and the site warns that spatial data is informational and subject to maintenance/revision.

source: Tamil Nadu Department of Survey and Settlement / Sivaganga district Survey and Land Records / TN-GLMS (public cadastral-service leads; direct parcel API not verified)
